text:
Jennifer: Heads-up — final checklist for marketplace launch tomorrow 09:00 PST. Need owners for: press embargo, landing cutover, SI integration toggle, partner logos + legal signoff, CDN purge, tracking/UTMs. Ping if you own any. Runbook: https://redwood.company/runbooks/marketplace-launch

mike: I'm on CDN purge and cutover. Will run staging->prod sync at T-15. CDN purge script: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.cdn.example/purge -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CDN_KEY' -d '{"paths":["/marketplace/*"]}'
```

priya: PR embargo — partners asked for 09:00 PST release. Need final quotes from CloudVendor by 06:00 PST. I can chase. Press distribution list: press@partners + partner-PR alias.

oliver: SI toggle is feature flag `marketplace.integrations.si_v1`. I'll deploy canary and monitor errors. If latency spike > 100ms I'll roll back.

samir: Partner logos: received hi-res from EdgeHardware, waiting on CloudVendor legal for brand kit. Landing copy — I have a short blurb, need to confirm H1 with marketing.

maria: I'll add UTM params + GA events. Use `utm_source=partners&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=launch2026`. Also will add a conversion event `marketplace_signup`.

legal: Please attach partner MOUs and any logo usage terms. We need explicit permission for co-branding. I'll sign off once we have MOUs by 04:00 PST.

deploy-bot: staging cutover started by mike at 2026-03-20T22:40:00Z — job 8472. Check staging URL: https://staging.redwood.ai/marketplace

Jennifer: Thanks. @mike confirm the CDN purge window? Also @oliver can you add an automatic fallback to open-api-light model if SI backends fail? We need a graceful degrade.

mike: Purge window T+0 to T+5, I'll do a rolling purge to avoid cold cache. Tagging ops-oncall. Ops runbook: https://redwood.company/ops/purge-runbook

oliver: Will add fallback. Flag snippet: `if (flags['marketplace.integrations.si_v1'] && siHealthy()) { routeToSI() } else { routeToFallback('open-api-light') }`

priya: Press contact confirmed: emily@cloudvendor.com. I'm sending embargoed release and placeholder quotes now. Also prepping the one-page memo for partners.

samir: Banner for hardware partner — can we reserve a hero slot and timeline for shipping notes? Need a content owner for the banner by EOD.

legal: Signed MOUs incoming from EdgeHardware at 03:20 PST. We still need IP indemnity clause for CloudVendor.

Jennifer: OK. Final checklist items assigned: CDN/mike, SI/oliver, PR/priya, logos/samir, analytics/maria, legal/legal. If no blockers by 06:30 PST we go. :thumbsup: 

mike: I'll post a final 'go/no-go' at 06:15 PST.

priya: I’ll confirm partner quote & embargo acceptance by 05:45 PST.

oliver: Canary rollout plan uploaded: https://redwood.company/infra/canaries/marketplace-canary. Rollback script included.

samir: Copy for the hero banner attached to the doc. Need last QA on mobile at 05:50 PST.

Jennifer: Great — thanks everyone. If anything changes ping this thread and @channel for any urgent rollbacks.
